execution.progress: prepare: an inspection round, then paid assembly rounds that persist across interruption; other modes take one round.

details.costs: Study: 3 rounds. prepare: x, y in reach, orientation; materials: exactly 5 own whole untreated wood units (first 2 supports); optional food and quantity, the proposed load. Round 1 inspects pieces and site, 1 energy; a shortfall is reported and nothing reserved. Then 3 assembly rounds, 1 energy each; prepare naming the rack resumes. load: rack, food (own stack), quantity (at most 4), controlQuantity kept carried as tracked control; 1 round, 0.5 per unit loaded. unload: 0.5 per unit. inspect (anyone) or compare (at least 5 paired rounds): 1 round, 0.5. maintain: replace (piece ids) and as many materials; 1 round, 1. dismantle (empty): 1. cancel: 0. Refusals cost nothing; an unworked round pauses free.
details.effects: A unit is a 0.04 x 0.99 m rod (branch). Supports lie 0.8 m apart on firm ground; crosspieces 0.08 m apart make a 0.8 x 0.2 m deck 0.08 m up, one layer of 4 units, rated twice the weakest crosspiece (37 kg each: wood strength/2, bend 0.02 half-span). Pieces become one rack; none stays loose. Loading splits the stack exactly (decay, harvest, origin kept) and lays the lot on the deck under the food water rules; rain wets it, and rain water dries off at their evaporation limit. The decay increment of whole roots there is x0.8 (declared model coefficient) only while the rack is complete and sound, the lot fits, no other material lies on it, there is no rain or standing water, it is outdoors with wind and 0.25 m clear of solids, and the lot is not wetter or warmer than its control (without one, its loading water); else x1. Compare: decay gained by lot and control, exposure, the share unequal temperature explains, verdict. Wear 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind) a round; a loose crosspiece stops the rate, a loose support drops the food. No reward, refund or food.

execution.progress: Atomic: each inspect or measure is one paid round that commits when it completes; nothing is reserved, paused or resumed.

details.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect or measure: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target in reach; specimen is a unit number (default 1). measure: one property; length or diameter needs tools naming a serviceable item with a verified length calibration record, mass a calibrated balance with a verified tare, volume method cylinder and your current length and diameter readings of that unit; tool readings need light; every value needs a separated whole plain unit. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel and other specimens or properties are separate actions.
details.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, method, tool and calibration provenance, value, units, resolution, uncertainty, conditions, scope and limits. inspect: form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment, wholeness; metric values unavailable without a calibrated reference (none exists here; body size, coordinates and stock are never used). measure: value rounded to the resolution; uncertainty = placements x (calibration uncertainty + half the resolution), plus 1% of the length for a strand laid out by hand; below resolution or over range is a paid limit with no value. Units in place, partial or worked items get no reading. Moisture and rigidity are unavailable. construct-weather-shelter@1 rod checks are judged over the uncertainty (meets, fails, indeterminate); suitability stays undetermined unless a check fails. A reading covers that unit and goes stale when its record changes. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. No reward.

execution.progress: Atomic one-round steps; a pending transfer waits for an explicit paid verify or resume, never advances on its own and holds no lock.

details.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. investigate: 1 round, 0.2 energy, one target in reach. transfer and verify: 1 round, 0.2 energy each; source is a serviceable item or object in reach with a complete verified length calibration record (none exists here); carrier is one separated whole, rigid, plain, sound wood unit, yours or loose in reach, no longer than the source range; light. No marking, cutting or expendables. resume runs the next step at its cost; cancel is free. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel, gathering and reading records are separate actions.
details.effects: investigate: a personal record and event of observed facts, unsupported claims and unknowns: calibration record status, and whether the piece is an uncalibrated comparison span (a non-metric record, never a calibration); conclusion "no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates" unless one qualifies. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. transfer: the carrier is laid end to end beside the source and read; calibration pending. verify: a second reading; if they agree, the carrier gets a reference-length record that examine-material reads: span = resolution = range, uncertainty = placements x (source uncertainty + resolution) + reading difference; no subdivisions or diameter. Any change of the carrier makes it stale; time never restores it. Without a source: refused, zero progress. No reward.

execution.progress: Atomic: one paid round that commits when it completes; an interrupted round completes no assessment and a retry is a new paid one. Nothing is reserved, paused or resumed.

details.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. assess: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target and specimen (unit number) within reach; evidenceRefs: up to 4 exact ids of your complete records (record key or its evidence id, eating record, heard message id, earlier assessment), [] for none; optional methodRef (installed capability or your record), equipmentRefs (your items, loose items or objects in reach), quantity (above 0, at most 1 unit; nothing is taken). Every check precedes payment: malformed or inaccessible input is refused free. execute-validated-method is refused free while no validated protocol exists; none does here. Reading records is consult, inspecting is examine-material, at their own costs.
details.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, cited ids and versions, candidate method, equipment, conditions, round, applicability and currency checks, provenance and limits. Direct observations, validated findings, unverified claims (labels, signs, heard or received records) and unknowns are separate; toxicity, edibility and preparation are reported independently, each unknown unless a validated method supports it, with the unmet requirements: identification reference, validated protocol, its equipment, controls, materials and safe conditions. Records about other subjects, units or sources, or stale ones, do not apply. Absence of a result is not a negative result. In darkness no new visual identification is made. No food value is read or shown; nothing is handled, tasted, consumed, moved or reserved. No reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. Work records marked settled are completed, stopped or cancelled and show only identity, ability, mode, status, target, products and last payment; an exact state query with the same key returns the complete record. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
